changelog: Pull down on a device's live monitor to refresh: it now runs an immediate pass-through read (Input / AC / Solar / Output and battery) and refreshes the cloud device state at once, while the every-5-seconds background poll keeps running.
Text fields now use 12px side padding, and the clear (✕) button sits just off the end of the underline instead of on top of it.
The Sleep Mode time picker opens inline just below the row you tapped and pushes the other time row down, so it no longer covers it.
Push Notifications settings use switches for Power Outage and Low Battery instead of On/Off chevrons; setting list rows (Push + Support) now share one icon and text size.
Sleep Mode adds 16px of breathing room above its first card.
Notifications rows now centre the timestamp and unread dot vertically instead of pinning them to the top line.
Feedback uses a proper auto-growing text area (no underline), and the email field sits closer to it.
Insights gives the date selector bar more room, 24px above and below.
